content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Solana payment

Solana payments represent a decentralized approach to receiving funds for digital products. Unlike traditional platforms such as PayPal or Gumroad, which impose steep fees, Solana allows for nearly instant transactions with minimal costs. When selling a $97 ebook, Gumroad would charge you 10%, which equates to $9.70 per sale. In contrast, NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, meaning you keep $96.50 per sale. This difference can accumulate significantly, especially for active sellers, amplifying your revenue potential.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture for using Solana payments revolves around several key components. At its core, you have a digital storefront hosted on platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, equipped with backend functionalities powered by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. This setup allows you to manage product listings and handle orders seamlessly. Integrating NOWPayments for crypto transactions ensures that payments are processed quickly, with confirmations happening on-chain. This infrastructure not only streamlines the buying process but also guarantees that you maintain ownership of your sales data and digital assets.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed specifically for digital creators across regions where conventional payment systems fail to operate effectively. If you're selling ebooks, courses, templates, or any digital products in countries like Nigeria, Kenya, or Venezuela, this stack offers a reliable solution. By utilizing Solana payments, you ensure that financial barriers do not limit your ability to monetize your creative work. This approach empowers you to reach global markets without relying on traditional platforms that might restrict or charge excessively.
Retain 91% more revenue compared to platforms like Gumroad.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The effective deployment of this infrastructure hinges on various components working in harmony. You begin with a hosting solution like GitHub Pages, allowing you to display your products. Next, the backend logic is managed through Cloudflare Workers, which handle the order processing and delivery automation. For data storage, integrating Supabase or Google Sheets is essential. Lastly, NOWPayments facilitates the crypto payment processing, handling over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees. Together, these elements create a cohesive and efficient digital commerce stack.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, first assess your digital products and choose the right stack for your needs, such as the Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack. Next, set up your hosting environment on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Proceed to configure the backend using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script and link your product storage solution. Finally, integrate NOWPayments for transaction processing. By following these steps, you'll have a fully operational digital store ready to accept payments.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider using a sovereign commerce stack that integrates with Solana payments. This setup allows you to accept cryptocurrency directly, eliminating platform fees while retaining ownership of your revenue. By leveraging tools like NOWPayments, digital creators can maximize profits and streamline transactions.
Instant payment confirmations mean faster access to your funds.

More details can be found at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.

You can sell an ebook online by using a digital commerce stack that leverages Solana payments. This allows you to accept cryptocurrency directly, bypassing PayPal or Stripe altogether, while keeping your transaction fees low.

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts without relying on Gumroad or Payhip by setting up your own online store using a sovereign commerce stack. This setup gives you full control over your sales and customer data.
How does NOWPayments work for digital products?
NOWPayments processes cryptocurrency payments for your digital products. It offers over 300 cryptocurrencies with a low transaction fee of 0.5%, ensuring you receive payments instantly and securely.
What are the advantages of using Solana for payments?

Using Solana for payments offers several advantages, including low transaction fees, fast processing times, and no reliance on traditional banking systems. This makes it an ideal choice for digital creators in regions with payment restrictions.
